note: Why the reference pictures of Brightline Home's fictional sample recall BH-2026-01 changed, and what the right-product score (C1) read before and after. The figures are counted by referencePictures() in src/components/judges/errors.ts from the two runs named here; nothing below is typed in by hand except the reasons. Thresholds and prompts did not change.
why: In all three sweep trials and the recorded preset, the sample charger with its cord cut scored 0.75 on the right-product check, under the 0.85 bar, and was verified only through the two reviewers. The model named what it could not compare: the case is opened and no label is in the owner's photo. The second reference picture it was given was a 440 by 340 crop of the whole-charger picture, mostly the area where the label had been removed, with the cord's strain relief small at its lower edge. A firm's recall notice shows the product, the place the remedy acts on, and its connectors, so the sample recall now publishes three pictures of the same public-domain charger: the whole charger (unchanged), where the cord meets the case (a new crop of the original photo below the label, so no brand mark is in it), and the DC plug (from a second public-domain photo of the same charger). The claim path still sends the first two to Claude.
